packages.label: 顶层模块

packages.label: blocks 可组合块
packages.desc: 20 个自描述块：spec / points / sim / opt / analyze / netlist / env / em / lib

packages.label: eval 评估引擎
packages.desc: engine.run：并发调度、预算、资源包络、Ctrl-C 与超时传递

packages.label: stages 阶段流水线
packages.desc: spectre 链（netlist → spectre/ocean → 标量）与 EM 链（pcell → emx → bind_nport）

packages.label: executor 执行器

packages.label: sim 电路仿真
packages.desc: OCEAN 脚本生成与标量解析、网表 deck、角点

packages.label: suggesters 建议器
packages.desc: TuRBO、OpenBox（默认）、Sobol / 拉丁超立方 / 随机

packages.label: em EM 量测
packages.desc: EMX 设置与命令行、Touchstone 读写、nport 网表补丁、measure（sNp → 结果列）

blocks.desc: Check executor, tools, license, exports, site envelope, budget

blocks.desc: What a stratum covers: rows, ranges, levels, quantities

blocks.desc: Where to simulate next: n geometries that cut the models' uncertainty most, for lib_signoff

blocks.desc: Build or read each stratum's dataset; integrity evidence

blocks.name: lib.query
blocks.desc: Measured values, or predictions with calibrated bounds and domain verdicts

blocks.desc: The region meeting target windows: robust and mean sweep ranges, groups, trend

recipes.name: lib_signoff
recipes.desc: Built-in recipe: lib_signoff -- run library candidates through real EMX, compare with the predictions, optionally adopt them.

recipes.desc: Built-in recipe: optimize — today's "optimize" mode for any tb × corner shape.

recipes.name: signoff
recipes.desc: Built-in recipe: signoff — optimize at one corner, then re-check the top-k across all corners.
